text:
I live in Houston TX and I rarely visit theater as I have my own top-notch theater at home (175" screen with 4K projector with 7.2 channel surround sound audio), so when wife bought Hanuman Ansh tickets in AMC for the whole family ($20/person) I was like "Seriously? $20 for such a movie?? I'll most probably just sleep throughout the movie", and then the movie started and I grabbed my phone to avoid falling asleep, a few minutes passed and the story + music started gripping me and soon my phone went in my pocket... until the end...! WOW, what an experience !!! 
I was pleasantly shocked ! My heart was filled with warmth and eyes with tears and I didn't even know about "Neem Karoli Baba", never even heard his name (sorry, I am kind of a hardcore so called "materialistic" person) ! And when I came out of theater, I was singing "Sita Ram"... 🙂 
 
I am so impressed by this movie (story as well as the mesmerizing music), I am planning to visit the "Neem Karoli Baba Ashram" in Taos, New Mexico soon!! 
 
Anyways, absolutely worth the $20 ticket... by any yardstick...period !!! 
 
Can't thank my wife enough for forcing me to come and watch this gem of a movie !!
